comparison.objective: Mount a shaft between bench centers while operating a spring-loaded tailstock lever.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual lever holding, end seating, axial alignment, and controlled spring-center engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Both shaft ends are seated between centers, tailstock engaged, shaft stable, and hands released.
comparison.reason: This is axial workpiece capture between opposed centers. Shared bimanual alignment is generic; it lacks sliding across a flush support seam and loose-ball containment.
